Welcome to our cozy detached house in Dal – a comfortable and convenient place to stay, good for both families and company stays.

The house is located in a quiet and safe neighborhood, with a short distance to Gardermoen, conference centers and other facilities in the area.

Here you can relax after work or travel, enjoy a private outdoor space, or use the home for both short and long stays.

We welcome you to a house that combines comfort, space and good location.
